units.passage: integrating AI throughout the curriculum strategically enhances teaching and learning while preparing students for an AI-ready workforce across disciplines.
units.why: "integrating AI throughout the curriculum strategically enhances teaching and learning while preparing students for an AI-ready workforce" is a career-readiness rationale, P44.

units.passage: At UF, our commitment to preparing you for the 21st century workforce involves working with artificial intelligence (AI) broadly across all disciplines.
units.why: 'our commitment to preparing you for the 21st century workforce involves working with artificial intelligence (AI) broadly across all disciplines' is a career rationale for engaging with AI (P44).

units.passage: As the landscape of AI technology is rapidly advancing, you must prioritize the ability to acquire the necessary skills to effectively utilize AI tools, ensuring you can leverage technology, where necessary to enhance your educational outcomes.
units.why: 'you must prioritize the ability to acquire the necessary skills to effectively utilize AI tools' makes AI skills a student responsibility, which is the professional-skill idea (P44).
units.fit_note: Phrased as a student duty rather than a reason.

units.passage: Open conversations with students about the acceptable use of AI encourages transparency and accountability, preparing them to apply AI responsibly in future careers and professional environments.
units.why: The same sentence gives a rationale: such conversations prepare students "to apply AI responsibly in future careers and professional environments", a career-preparation rationale (P44).

units.passage: Through a thoughtful implementation of AI technologies, the university is preparing tomorrow's leaders with the skills they need to apply AI technologies across disciplines in a way that is both innovative and responsible.
units.why: "preparing tomorrow's leaders with the skills they need to apply AI technologies across disciplines" is a career-readiness rationale (P44).

units.passage: Build the knowledge and skills needed to work with AI tools effectively and responsibly.
units.why: "Build the knowledge and skills needed to work with AI tools effectively and responsibly" frames AI skill as something students should develop (P44).

units.passage: The course will include discussions on best practices for AI usage.
units.why: Green Light: "The course will include discussions on best practices for AI usage" means the course teaches AI use (P44).

units.passage: Integrate AI technologies in your day-to-day workflow by learning the core concepts of artificial intelligence and generative AI functionality.
units.why: LinkedIn Learning is offered to 'Integrate AI technologies in your day-to-day workflow', literacy training that teaches AI as a skill; P44.

units.passage: Fordham has an opportunity to help students develop AI literacy to evaluate the implications of GAI tools and, thus, use them ethically and responsibly.
units.why: States Fordham "has an opportunity to help students develop AI literacy" so they use tools "ethically and responsibly"; AI literacy as a skill, P44.

units.passage: Additionally, it is essential to educate students to use GAI responsibly and ethically, enabling them to make informed decisions while harnessing the potential of this powerful technology.
units.why: Says "it is essential to educate students to use GAI responsibly and ethically", an education commitment about responsible use, so P44.

units.passage: Fordham University is committed to promoting critical AI literacy among students, faculty, and staff.
units.why: Declares the university "committed to promoting critical AI literacy among students, faculty, and staff"; teaching AI use as a skill (P44).

units.passage: Provide technical support and guidance to students, faculty, and staff on the effective utilization of GAI.
units.why: Recommends "technical support and guidance to students, faculty, and staff on the effective utilization of GAI" via tutorials and workshops; effective-use skill (P44).

units.passage: consideration should be given to appropriately preparing students for post-graduation studies and careers in a world with these tools.
units.why: Asks program leaders to consider "preparing students for post-graduation studies and careers in a world with these tools"; career rationale, P44.

units.passage: The committee recommends active collaboration with industry leaders to gain valuable insights into the future of knowledge work and the expected AI literacy of graduates.
units.why: Recommends "active collaboration with industry leaders" to learn "the expected AI literacy of graduates"; career-relevant AI skill, P44.

units.passage: Users must cultivate AI literacy by understanding its workings, capabilities, and limitations, critically questioning AI content for validity and biases
units.why: 'Users must cultivate AI literacy by understanding its workings, capabilities, and limitations' is an AI-literacy duty; P44 (teach effective AI use as a skill) is nearest as no literacy type exists.

units.passage: employers are expecting new graduates to know how to use AI to be more efficient and productive
units.why: 'employers are expecting new graduates to know how to use AI'; career rationale, P44.

units.passage: you should nonetheless understand how to use it and how to leverage these systems at least to the level expected by employers
units.why: 'you should nonetheless understand how to use it' even if inclined to reject AI; professional skill, P44.

units.passage: Effectively using AI includes evaluating, correcting, and enhancing AI outputs, and you need to be able to show that you have the ability to do so
units.why: 'Effectively using AI includes evaluating, correcting, and enhancing AI outputs'; professional skill and value-add, P44.

units.passage: You might think, and ask students to think, about how similar tools have changed the work of your field and thus the skills and abilities that educated professionals need
units.why: Compares AI to calculators, spelling checkers etc. and asks faculty to consider how tools change needed skills; P44 (professional skill shifts) fits since P45 is about human collaborators.

units.passage: There will be times in X field that use of AI tools will be needed for you to do well at the job
units.why: 'use of AI tools will be needed for you to do well at the job': career rationale, P44.

units.passage: gaining experience in the ethical and efficient use of these tools will help you in your professional life once you have left the university
units.why: 'gaining experience in the ethical and efficient use of these tools will help you in your professional life'; P44.
